# Desktop app dependencies (cross-platform native shell via pywebview).
# pywebview uses the OS-native webview — no bundled Chromium, no Node.
pywebview>=5.0
httpx>=0.27
# PyInstaller is required to build the distributable desktop app
# (desktop/build-{macos,windows,linux}.py). A fresh `vgctl desktop install-deps`
# now installs it, so the desktop app is buildable straight out of the box.
pyinstaller>=6.0
